canonical_data: agent graph definitions, execution state snapshots, conversation history, and vector retrieval indexes
current_repo_note: Default branch is develop; license evidence pinned from LICENSE.txt on that branch.
strengths: Kotlin Multiplatform targets across JVM, JS, Wasm, Android, and iOS with Spring and Ktor embedding for enterprise JVM shops
Reliability machinery is built in: retries, state persistence with restore points, and history compression
Six maintained provider integrations plus Ollama behind a switchable contract with history adaptation, alongside MCP and ACP support
weaknesses: JetBrains incubator status and a develop-branch workflow signal API instability ahead of maturity
JVM and Kotlin centered; other platforms are reached only through multiplatform targets
Production hardening, permissions, and cost controls stay application-defined
why_it_matters: Represents the enterprise-JVM approach to agents: type-safe, fault-tolerant orchestration that meets Kotlin shops where they are.
